summary: A March 2026 interview profile reports Sakakihara pushed Union City to consider a Gaza ceasefire resolution in 2024 and advocated an ethical investment policy; it does not establish a final council vote.
quote: He also pushed for Union City to consider a Gaza ceasefire resolution in 2024
date_note: Date is the interview/profile publication. The described council effort was in 2024; its exact date and final vote are not established.
